blocks.x: BI & Analytics Platform in the field — deployment patterns by industry, with committed outcomes.
Rollouts follow the Achala Method on this platform's rails:

items: baseline metrics locked; data-readiness assessed against the platform's contracts.
pilot on a bounded scope with falsifiable criteria and the platform configured for your controls.
staged rollout with SLO instrumentation, replay evidence and operator enablement.
challenger models/policies, conformance monitoring, quarterly value reviews.

blocks.x: Day to day, the operating team sees one control surface: health, throughput, cost and policy violations for the workloads BI & Analytics Platform carries. Escalations arrive with the context attached — the runbook, the affected scope, the last passing evidence — instead of a raw alert and a hunch.

OPC UA, MQTT Sparkplug B, LoRaWAN/NB-IoT, KubeEdge/K3s, CMMS/MES adapters — integrated through versioned contracts. Adapters to core systems (CRM, ERP, core banking, EHR, WMS/MES, SCADA) are maintained like products: schema changes are tested against consumer suites before release, and one contract update propagates to every human or agent consumer.
